# The Black Marks

*Osric wants a black line marked along the forest edge that no cutter goes past. Bring him 25 Slater Plates for the tar, and tell Haldor what the marks are for.*

|---|---|

## Objectives

- Bring 25 [Slater Plate](../items/slater_plate.md) (taken)

- 20,000 EXP
- 1,600 mesos
- [Elixir](../items/elixir.md) x3
